visual_review: Direct original review shows open red-column pavilions above water, connected by a covered gallery with green posts, low geometric rails and gray stone/concrete platforms supported above the water. Gray tiled eaves have round tile ends; blue/green/gold beam paintings and red hanging lanterns separate the timber members. Reflections show the underside clearance and platform supports. The gallery identifies this as Ouxiang; no building name is legible within the selected image itself.
